detection_rule: At least one GT anomaly record at or above that model's full-val19 operating threshold.
primary_metric_distinction: Binary detection is only for symmetric case selection; the primary target metric remains mean within-instance point recall.
sampling_rule: Same seed 20260917 and sequence-balanced round-robin for both directions; at most 6 per direction per workpoint, equal sample size; sorted identities shuffled within each shuffled sequence. No selection on score margin or appearance.
geometry_scope: Actual full-scan observation identities; model nearest_returns selects self plus 31 neighbors. Context normals use known non-anomaly semantic labels including context outside the metric range.
limitations: Frame-instance observations may repeat physical objects across frames.
Normal semantic categories are retained in the raw labels; true physical height and occlusion are not supplied for these val19 instances.
Local geometry describes observations and does not establish a causal explanation.
Binary disagreement samples exclude partial-recall changes when both models detect the instance.
